Traits Paradise-Touched

Whenever two Static results you have received in the same session contradict each other, the GM must tell you that a contradiction exists, as soon as the second result is delivered. You are told that two of your answers disagree and which two; you are never told which one is false, and the secret flat checks behind them are never revealed. This is a standing obligation on the GM, not something you spend or activate.
